parameters.name: AllocationType
parameters.description:
The allocate type. Valid values:

- Normal: queries SCUs that belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- Shared: queries SCUs that are shared between the Alibaba Cloud account and a Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

Default value: Normal.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the SCU. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the SCU list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the SCU. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The statuses of SCUs. Array length: 1 to 4.

parameters.name: StorageCapacityUnitId
parameters.description: The IDs of SCUs. Array length: 1 to 100.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the SCU.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the SCU.
